  • Interface Summary 
    Interface Description
    ICalendarView
    Implements the ICalendarView interface, responsible for presenting the calendar data to the user by outputting the response to a specified output medium.
  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    ActionPanel
    ActionPanel is an abstract class for building user interface components within the calendar application and add an action after to perform on the input values.
    CalendarView
    Implements the ICalendarView interface, responsible for presenting the calendar data to the user by outputting the response to a specified output medium.
    CreateEventPane
    CreateEventPane is a user interface panel that facilitates the creation of new events within the calendar application.
    DayEventsPanel
    DayEventsPanel is a user interface component that displays all events scheduled for a specific date.
    EditEventPane
    EditEventPane is a user interface panel that allows users to edit the details of an existing calendar event.
    EditEventsPane
    EditEventPane is a user interface panel that allows users to edit the details of multiple existing calendar events.
    EventTab
    EventTab is a reusable UI component for both creating and editing calendar events.
    GUICalendarView
    GUICalendarView is a graphical user interface implementation of the ICalendarView interface.
    UIPanel
    UIPanel is an abstract base class for building user interface components within the calendar application.
